name: Georg Gajdosch — wife Catharina and daughter Anna (b. 1718, Lidečko)
researcher_question: Did Georg Gajdosch of Lidečko, Moravia have a daughter Anna, baptised 22 April 1718 — and was her mother named Catharina rather than the Dorothea the tree records as his wife?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 7, hint-samples.csv row 243, flags adds_spouse/adds_daughter, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-09-16 (issue #2300): FALSE MATCH. Lidečko held two contemporaneous Georg Gajdosch couples — baptisms eight days apart in 1714 name Dorothea and Catharina as mothers, so they are neither one woman nor successive wives. The tree person rests solely on the Dorothea entry; the 1718 Anna baptism belongs to the Catharina couple. Findings are an avoid/required pair; no substitute daughter exists in the collection.
